slogan: Even those who cannot read can accomplish everything.

phasePeechaKarnaDesc: Track status & call office if stalled

micPlaceholderTitle: Tap Mic to Speak or use Spoken Voice Commands below
textInputPlaceholder: Type your issue here (e.g. Meri pension band ho gayi)...
presetPensionBtn: “Meri pension band ho gayi” (My pension stopped)
serviceConfirmTitle: Aapko pension chalu karwani hai, sahi? (You want to restore your pension, right?)
madadKendraMessage: Welcome to NagarSathi Madad Kendra. Our support desk assists you with all citizen services—including Scholarships, Pension restoration, Ration card updates, Income & Domicile certificates, application tracking, and grievances. Please visit your nearest Madad Kendra or call toll-free 1800-111-555.
madadKendraStep1: 1. Keep your Aadhaar Card and Bank Passbook ready.
madadKendraStep2: 2. Tap the big green call button below to speak with a helpdesk operator.
consentCanDo1: Fill your government portal application as a DRAFT
consentCanDo3: Place a follow-up call to the office if your file stalls
consentCannotDo1: Submit any form without your explicit approval
consentCannotDo2: Pay money or withdraw funds from your bank account
consentCannotDo3: Share your personal data with third parties
consentHaltedMessage: Because you declined consent, nothing was saved and no application was created.
saveProfileQuestionTitle: Agli baar ke liye data save karun? (Save profile for next time?)
saveProfileExplanation: Important: Case data automatically deletes in 30 days. A saved profile stays until you delete it.
saveProfileYesBtn: ✓ Yes, Save Profile for Next Time
saveProfileNoBtn: No, Use Only for This Case (30-Day Auto-Delete)
docsRetryExpiredBtn: 📷 Capture Renewed Life Certificate (Fix Old Certificate)
docsWarningBlurry: Photo dhundhli hai, dobara (Photo is blurry, please retake).
docsWarningExpired: Life certificate purana hai (Life certificate is outdated, please provide current certificate).
docsAllVerifiedMsg: All required documents verified and ready (DOCS_READY)!

gate2VoiceConfirmFinalBtn: 🟢 Big Green Button: Confirm & Submit Now
gate2HaltedTitle: Flow Stopped — Nothing Submitted (Halted at Gate 2)

submittedScreenSubtitle: Your Pension Restoration application was submitted after your explicit Gate 2 approval.

trackingQueryQuestion: Life certificate purana hai — please capture and upload a renewed Digital Life Certificate.
trackingStalledAlert: ⚠️ Stalled for 7 days past SLA (7 din se ruka hai — 21 days elapsed).
trackingStartCallBtn: 📞 Place Simulated Follow-Up Call to Office
callScreenSubtitle: NagarSathi Caller Agent vs. Taluka Officer (Judge plays Office Officer)

callNextCheckSchedule: Next Check Scheduled: Will check again in 3 days (3 din mein dekhenge, REF-5521)
closedScreenTitle: Pension Phir Chalu Ho Gayi! (Pension Restored — Case Closed)

letterExplainerSubtitle: Take a photo of any government letter; NagarSathi will explain and read it aloud in simple words.
portalRetryFailedFinal: The government portal is currently unreachable after 3 attempts (dobara koshish 3/3). Do not worry, your draft is safely saved.
safetyRuleBanner: Safety Rule: Form filling creates a DRAFT only. Submit is strictly blocked unless approval.given === true.
approvalBlockedAlert: Submission blocked: You must explicitly approve the draft (approval.given === true) before submitting.
errorBoundaryMessage: Please reload the page or try again.
footerDisclaimer: Prototype. Mock portal. Demo data only.

auth.phase1Desc: Explain your problem by voice in your own language & give informed consent.
auth.phase2Desc: Verify documents & fill the government portal form as a safe DRAFT.
auth.phase3Desc: Track status, handle queries, and follow up until your case is resolved.
auth.signupSubtitle: Sign up once to track your applications and save your masked profile.
auth.loginSubtitle: Enter your 10-digit mobile number to receive a one-time verification code.
auth.termsLabel: I agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy (Gate 1 & Gate 2 safety rules).
auth.trustStrip: Your data stays masked. Nothing is submitted without your approval.
auth.onboardingSubtitle: Your citizen profile is protected with Aadhaar masking and two human approval gates.
